prompt: A wide view at knee height on the downs, the burnt-out kill bot from the first image big and dark in the right foreground, scorched and split open, smoke drifting off it, a crow on top. Beyond it and to its left, at middle distance, the small grey six-wheeled robot from the second image rolls away from us down the grassy slope, amber beacon lit, torn bunting on a wheel, a slim aerial with a little round hoop raised out of a hatch on her lid as in the third image. Far behind her, up on the left, the overgrown bunker with its plain shut green doors. Wide open downland and low grey cloud. Shot like a 1980s BBC drama on 16mm stock, washed-out colour, gentle contrast, thick grain. Widescreen, no lettering.
